title: Supplemental disaster relief appropriations
affects: Emergency management agencies, flood-affected counties, first responders
changes: Appropriates $294M in Rainy Day Fund money for FEMA match, flood sirens, forecasting, and training
business_impact: Disaster-response contractors and local governments gain access to new grant funding

title: Outdoor warning sirens in flood-prone areas
changes: Requires siren installation in high-risk flood zones and creates a state grant program to fund it
business_impact: Siren/alert-system vendors and local governments face new install and maintenance mandates

title: Groundwater permits and modeled available groundwater
affects: Groundwater conservation districts, water permit applicants
changes: Would require districts to weigh modeled available groundwater when issuing permits (bill filed, not passed)
business_impact: Companies seeking large groundwater transfer permits could face new limits if enacted

title: Handgun license eligibility for federal judges
changes: Adds U.S. immigration court judges to the definition of 'federal judge' eligible for expedited handgun licenses (bill filed, not passed)
business_impact: No business impact — affects individual judges' license eligibility only

title: Local emergency warning system opt-in via DMV
affects: Municipalities, counties, DMV, driver's license applicants
changes: Lets residents opt in via driver's license application to share contact info with local emergency alert systems (bill filed, not passed this session)
business_impact: Minimal direct business impact; local governments could gain a new resident contact database

title: County authority to regulate impervious cover
affects: County governments, developers, property owners in unincorporated areas
changes: Would let counties regulate impervious cover (pavement, roofs) to reduce flood risk (bill filed, not passed)
business_impact: Developers could face new county-level site coverage limits in unincorporated areas

title: Voter-approval tax rate reduction (1st special session)
changes: Lowers automatic property tax growth cap from 3.5% to 2.5% before voter approval required; passed Senate, died before House action
business_impact: Would have constrained local government tax revenue growth; superseded by SB 10 in 2nd special session

title: In memory of Bobby Gene Roberts Sr.
Heaven's 27 Camp Safety Act
changes: Bans floodplain cabins, requires emergency plans, muster zones, weather radios, redundant internet
business_impact: Camp operators face new licensing, infrastructure, and staff training costs

title: Voter-approval tax rate reduction
changes: Lowers the automatic property tax growth cap from 3.5% to 2.5% before voter approval is required
business_impact: May slow local property tax growth, affecting local government revenue and services

title: Texas Women's Privacy Act
affects: State agencies, schools, universities, prisons, shelters
changes: Requires restrooms/locker rooms designated by biological sex; sets civil penalties for violations
business_impact: Public institutions must update facility policies or face $25,000+ fines and lawsuits

title: Disaster preparedness and emergency manager licensing
affects: Emergency managers, TDEM, local governments, volunteers
changes: Creates tiered emergency manager license, volunteer database, and disaster loan program
business_impact: Emergency management professionals need new licenses; note: bill stalled and missed final passage

title: Real property theft and fraud offenses
affects: Property owners, title companies, county clerks
changes: Creates new felony crimes for deed/title fraud; requires photo ID to file property documents
business_impact: Title companies and clerks gain new ID-check duties; victims get restitution rights
